title: Pass-Through Expense Billing on Professional Services Projects
content:
**Professional Services Projects — expenses billed to the client.**

1. Travel within the class's included radius of the nearest Stratton Bay office is not billed.
2. Beyond it, round-trip mileage is billed at the class mileage rate per mile without markup.
3. Airfare, lodging, materials and shipping are billed at cost plus the class expense markup percentage, rounded half up to the cent.
4. Each expense is billed against its receipt or mileage log reference, and each receipt or log is billed once.
5. A single expense above the class pre-approval figure is billable only with the authorized contact's written pre-approval; without it the expense is absorbed.

| Expense | How it is billed |
|---|---|
| travel within the included radius | not billed |
| round-trip mileage beyond the included radius | the mileage rate per mile, no markup |
| airfare, lodging, materials, shipping | cost plus the markup percentage, rounded half up to the cent |
| a single expense above the pre-approval figure, without written pre-approval | absorbed |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A lodging receipt of 400.00 on an engagement whose markup is 10 percent is billed at 400.00 plus 40.00, that is 440.00. If the pre-approval figure of that engagement were 250.00, the receipt would be billable only with the authorized contact's written pre-approval, and absorbed without it.
